title: ==AUTOMATION TESTER==  ·  TEST SCRIPT DEVELOPMENT & QUALITY DELIVERY

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: Automation tester with **2 years of automation experience**. Performed automation testing and **created test scripts** with Playwright, Selenium (Java), and Cucumber BDD across UI and API layers. **Ensured quality delivery** by integrating automated suites into CI/CD pipelines, cutting release verification time from 3 days → 1 day.
